reviews.title: Initial subscription screen trap
reviews.text: Had to force quit the app TWICE to get past the subscription screen because there’s no way to X out of this screen and it’s the first thing you see when you download it, despite the subscription being “optional” and only for pro features. If there’s a free version, then GIVE ME THE OPTION TO GET PAST THE OFFER PAGE SO I CAN USE IT. Almost deleted it seconds after downloading it because of this. You can’t expect someone to immediately pay for an app they can’t even try out, and I’m not signing up for your free trial for pro without even understanding what’s offered in the free version. 2 stars for a terrible first impression.

reviews.title: Basically downloading an Advertisement App
reviews.text:
Tried downloading this to see if I liked it. As soon as I opened the app, a “Royal Match” ad popped up, and had no way of exiting out of it or it timing out. Left it going for over 5 minutes waiting to see if the ad would clear so I could check out the app trial, with no results. Closed the app and reopened, same thing. Over and over. 

The app might be great if you could actually use it at all.
